reason.summary: Two demonstrated failures: an omitted zero-intercept source case and coefficient patterns that predict consistency without elimination. The shortcut also answers the delivered five-question batch. Package unchanged.

source_analysis.skill: Use Gaussian elimination on a singular 2x2 system, distinguish a contradictory row from a redundant row, and select the general solution.
reasoning_steps: Normalize the first pivot when necessary and eliminate the second x entry.
Interpret the final row as a contradiction or redundancy.
Select No solution or the correct vector family.
invariants: Two variables, singular rank-one coefficient matrix, and an x-first pivot.
Easy cases require one elimination operation.
Both consistent and inconsistent outcomes belong to the skill.
Practice responses use five-choice radio fields.
permitted_variations: Vary coefficients and first-row constants, including zero.
Vary the second RHS independently so fixed coefficients can yield either consistency outcome.
Derive matrices, explanations, answer banks, and keys from the same instance.
source_refs: Tutorial 3153: solve the basic variable in terms of the free variable.
Tutorial 3901: a final equation 0=10 is false.
Tutorial 3154: the eliminated RHS distinguishes infinitely many solutions from no solution.
